humanTitle: People cannot keep up with a conversation that stutters
whoItAffects: iPhone and Android users in the UK, US and Canada, across three app versions.

build.proposition: A message list that renders only what is on screen.
specifics: Recycle rows as they scroll instead of holding every post in memory
Keep search off the render thread so typing stays responsive
Start with the scroll-up path reviewers describe freezing
build.limitation: A chat client carries years of features on one thread, and a rewrite touches all of them.

start.proposition: A lighter client for people who only need to read and reply.
specifics: Read, reply, and nothing else, on older hardware
Sold to the operations teams whose staff carry the oldest phones
start.limitation: Work chat is bought centrally, and a second client is a security review nobody wants.

study.proposition: Does message latency change what people write?
specifics: Compare reply length and speed on fast versus stuttering clients
Ask whether people move a conversation elsewhere when it lags
study.limitation: Chat contents are private, so this needs a consenting workplace rather than a dataset.

write.proposition: The app everyone must use and nobody can scroll.
specifics: Sit with someone working a shift through a stuttering client
Use the reviews describing a freeze on scrolling back
write.limitation: Enterprise-software complaint is a worn genre; the angle is people with no choice of client.
